channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Skydiving plane crash kills 11 in northeastern France
item.description: 11 people were killed when a plane belonging to a parachuting school crashed in Tomblaine, France.

item.title: Oil prices rise as US, Iranian strikes threaten Strait of Hormuz reopening
item.description: Brent crude edges up as tit-for-tat strikes hinder return to normality in key waterway.

item.title: Putin says Ukraine proposed halt to deep strikes
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin says Ukraine has proposed a mutual halt to long-range strikes

item.title: Pakistan says its security forces killed 29 fighters along Afghan border
item.description: Strikes come a day after fighters armed with guns and explosives killed three soldiers in Karachi.

item.title: US says it has agreed to 'stand down' after exchange of strikes with Iran
item.description: A series of strikes over the weekend saw the US and Iran accuse each other of violating the ceasefire agreement.

item.title: Pakistani strikes kill dozens in Afghanistan
item.description: The Taliban government says civilians were killed, while Pakistan maintains they targeted militants.

item.title: Europe's heatwave linked to 1,300 deaths, WHO says, as Germany hits record 41.7C
item.description: WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that Europe is not prepared for high temperatures.

item.title: Fourteen killed in Saudi Arabia helicopter crash
item.description: The aircraft belonged to state oil giant Aramco and the cause of the crash is being investigated.

item.title: Eleven killed after plane carrying skydivers crashes in eastern France
item.description: The pilot and 10 passengers - including five first-time parachutists - died in the incident, local officials said.

item.title: US and Iran exchange strikes and accuse each other of violating ceasefire
item.description: Iran says it has launched retaliatory attacks at US infrastructure in Kuwait and Bahrain after the US said it hit multiple targets across Iran.
